history.body: Hi, my partner and I are considering buying somewhere around Seberang Jaya. We both work from home some days, so the extra room and overall layout matter to us. Could you tell me a bit about Pearl Residences’ 3-bedroom option?

Pearl Residences’ 3-bedroom Type A is 900 sq ft, with 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, plus a layout without a long internal corridor, helps keep the layout efficient. The three bedrooms give you flexibility to consider using one as a work space; the concept shows queen-sized beds, but exact desk and furniture fit would need checking against the approved plan. If layout is a key factor, you’re welcome to view it and assess how it could work for both of you—no pressure.

Thanks, that’s useful—the extra room could work well as a quiet workspace. Since the exact desk fit depends on the approved plan, could you share it when available? I’d be open to seeing the unit once we’ve had a chance to check the plan, but we don’t need to set anything up just yet.

Sure—I’ll request the approved Type A plan so you can check the bedroom dimensions and desk fit before deciding about a visit. The third room could offer a separate quiet workspace if the approved layout works for your desks. No need to arrange a viewing yet.
